0: add_features: A weak, smoothed item-popularity prior computed only from training interactions may complement SASRec on sparse histories, especially in Electronics, the weakest category. Keep its contribution small to preserve personalized rankings, and persist the same prior in the generated predictor. Judge benefit by benchmark macro validation HR@10 and inspect category regressions.
1: tune_num_heads: Increasing heads previously improved validation over baseline. Test the next larger head count compatible with the existing embedding width on the larger-batch incumbent; more attention subspaces may capture complementary sequential patterns. Hold width, depth and optimization fixed, with matching predictor architecture.
2: tune_num_layers: Added depth previously reduced validation HR@10, supporting a cautious test of one fewer transformer layer while retaining at least one. Shallower SASRec may reduce overfitting in sparse categories and improve Electronics without sacrificing the stronger categories. Keep other settings fixed and synchronize predictor depth.
3: tune_batch_size: The previous batch increase improved benchmark macro validation HR@10 by 0.0325. Test a smaller further increase of about 25%, holding learning rate and the 200-epoch schedule fixed. Reduced gradient noise may extend the gain, but late improvement in CDs_and_Vinyl suggests that fewer updates could hurt convergence; inspect category regressions alongside the macro score.
